title: Pythagoras' theorem
svg: a = 3 units a² = 3² = 9 Side b = 4 units b² = 4² = 16 Side c = 5 units c² = 5² = 25 Sum of Squares: 9 + 16 = 25 a² = 9 b² = 16 c² = 25 a = 3 b = 4 c = 5 (hypotenuse) In any right-angled triangle: a² + b² = c²

title: Parts of a circle
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600">
  <title>Parts of a Circle</title>
  
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
  
  <!-- Heading -->
  <text x="400" y="48" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">Parts of a Circle</text>
  
  <!-- Main Circle Graphic Group -->
  <g id="circle-diagram">
    <!-- Background filled circle -->
    <circle cx="300" cy="310" r="140" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e0" stroke-width="2"/>
    
    <!-- Diameter Line (Static, Full width across centre) -->
    <line x1="160" y1="310" x2="440" y2="310" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="8,5"/>
    <circle cx="160" cy="310" r="5" fill="#d97706"/>
    <circle cx="440" cy="310" r="5" fill="#d97706"/>
    
    <!-- Animated Circumference Highlight Trace -->
    <!-- Circumference = 2 * pi * 140 = 879.6 -->
    <circle cx="300" cy="310" r="140" fill="none" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="879.6" stroke-dashoffset="879.6">
      <animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" values="879.6; 0" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    
    <!-- Animated Rotating Radius Line -->
    <g transform-box="fill-box">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 300 310" to="360 300 310" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <line x1="300" y1="310" x2="440" y2="310" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="4"/>
      <circle cx="440" cy="310" r="6" fill="#dc2626"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Centre Point -->
    <circle cx="300" cy="310" r="7" fill="#0f172a"/>
    <circle cx="300" cy="310" r="3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Diagram Labels and Pointer Lines -->
  
  <!-- 1. Circumference Label (Top Left) -->
  <path d="M 140 125 L 195 125 L 210 175" fill="none" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,3"/>
  <circle cx="210" cy="175" r="3" fill="#2563eb"/>
  <text x="135" y="118" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563eb">Circumference</text>
  <text x="135" y="136" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#475569">Distance around edge</text>

  <!-- 2. Centre Label (Bottom Left) -->
  <path d="M 170 440 L 225 440 L 295 316" fill="none" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,3"/>
  <circle cx="295" cy="316" r="3" fill="#0f172a"/>
  <text x="165" y="435" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">Centre</text>
  <text x="165" y="453" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#475569">Fixed middle point</text>

  <!-- 3. Diameter Label & Dimension Line (Below Centre Line) -->
  <line x1="160" y1="345" x2="440" y2="345" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="160" y1="338" x2="160" y2="352" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="440" y1="338" x2="440" y2="352" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="300" y="368" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#b45309">Diameter (d)</text>
  <text x="300" y="386" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#b45309">Across circle through centre</text>

  <!-- 4. Radius Label (Top Right) -->
  <path d="M 370 230 L 350 280" fill="none" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,3"/>
  <circle cx="350" cy="280" r="3" fill="#dc2626"/>
  <text x="375" y="225" text-anchor="start" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#dc2626">Radius (r)</text>
  <text x="375" y="243" text-anchor="start" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#991b1b">Centre to edge</text>

  <!-- Right Side Summary Panel -->
  <rect x="490" y="90" width="260" height="440" rx="12" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Panel Header -->
  <path d="M 490 102 A 12 12 0 0 1 502 90 L 738 90 A 12 12 0 0 1 750 102 L 750 135 L 490 135 Z" fill="#e2e8f0"/>
  <text x="620" y="118" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">Key Relationships</text>

  <!-- Main Formula Box: d = 2r -->
  <rect x="510" y="155" width="220" height="75" rx="8" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#fca5a5" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="620" y="188" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#991b1b">DIAMETER FORMULA</text>
  <!-- 5. Relationship Equation Label -->
  <text x="620" y="218" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" fill="#dc2626">d = 2r</text>

  <!-- Secondary Formula Box: r = d / 2 -->
  <rect x="510" y="245" width="220" height="55" rx="8" fill="#fffbe6" stroke="#fef08a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="620" y="278" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#b45309">r = d ÷ 2</text>

  <!-- Definitions List inside Panel -->
  <g transform="translate(510, 325)">
    <!-- Circumference Formula -->
    <circle cx="10" cy="10" r="4" fill="#2563eb"/>
    <text x="22" y="14" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">Circumference (C)</text>
    <!-- 6. Circumference Formula Text -->
    <text x="22" y="34" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563eb">C = πd = 2πr</text>

    <!-- Key Bullet Points -->
    <circle cx="10" cy="65" r="4" fill="#64748b"/>
    <text x="22" y="69" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#334155">Radius is <tspan font-weight="bold">half</tspan> the diameter</text>

    <circle cx="10" cy="95" r="4" fill="#64748b"/>
    <text x="22" y="99" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#334155">Diameter is <tspan font-weight="bold">double</tspan> radius</text>

    <circle cx="10" cy="125" r="4" fill="#64748b"/>
    <text x="22" y="129" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#334155">π (pi) ≈ 3.142</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Outer Safe Area Border (Invisible, ensures layout integrity) -->
  <rect x="30" y="30" width="740" height="540" fill="none"/>
</svg>

title: Series circuit

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600">
  <title>Series Circuit</title>
  
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- Title Banner -->
  <text x="400" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">Series Circuit: Current & Voltage</text>
  <text x="400" y="58" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#475569">Single continuous loop • No branches</text>

  <!-- Legend for Conventional Current -->
  <rect x="575" y="30" width="185" height="30" rx="6" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#fca5a5" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="667" y="50" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#dc2626">➔ Conventional Current</text>

  <!-- Circuit Wire Loop (Background) -->
  <path d="M 400 140 H 620 V 410 H 180 V 140 H 400" fill="none" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Animated Current Dots (Charges moving clockwise) -->
  <g fill="#2563eb" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5">
    <circle r="6"><animateMotion path="M 400 140 L 620 140 L 620 410 L 180 410 L 180 140 Z" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0s"/></circle>
    <circle r="6"><animateMotion path="M 400 140 L 620 140 L 620 410 L 180 410 L 180 140 Z" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="-0.6s"/></circle>
    <circle r="6"><animateMotion path="M 400 140 L 620 140 L 620 410 L 180 410 L 180 140 Z" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="-1.2s"/></circle>
    <circle r="6"><animateMotion path="M 400 140 L 620 140 L 620 410 L 180 410 L 180 140 Z" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="-1.8s"/></circle>
    <circle r="6"><animateMotion path="M 400 140 L 620 140 L 620 410 L 180 410 L 180 140 Z" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="-2.4s"/></circle>
    <circle r="6"><animateMotion path="M 400 140 L 620 140 L 620 410 L 180 410 L 180 140 Z" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="-3.0s"/></circle>
    <circle r="6"><animateMotion path="M 400 140 L 620 140 L 620 410 L 180 410 L 180 140 Z" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="-3.6s"/></circle>
    <circle r="6"><animateMotion path="M 400 140 L 620 140 L 620 410 L 180 410 L 180 140 Z" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="-4.2s"/></circle>
    <circle r="6"><animateMotion path="M 400 140 L 620 140 L 620 410 L 180 410 L 180 140 Z" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="-4.8s"/></circle>
    <circle r="6"><animateMotion path="M 400 140 L 620 140 L 620 410 L 180 410 L 180 140 Z" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="-5.4s"/></circle>
  </g>

  <!-- Conventional Current Direction Arrows -->
  <polygon points="465,134 477,140 465,146" fill="#dc2626"/>
  <polygon points="614,335 620,347 626,335" fill="#dc2626"/>
  <polygon points="255,404 243,410 255,416" fill="#dc2626"/>
  <polygon points="174,195 180,183 186,195" fill="#dc2626"/>

  <!-- CELL (Top Wire) -->
  <rect x="370" y="115" width="60" height="50" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Negative Terminal (Short Thick Line) -->
  <line x1="385" y1="123" x2="385" y2="157" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Positive Terminal (Long Thin Line) -->
  <line x1="415" y1="112" x2="415" y2="168" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cell Terminal Labels -->
  <text x="372" y="125" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">-</text>
  <text x="424" y="125" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#dc2626">+</text>
  <!-- Cell Text Label -->
  <text x="400" y="88" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">Cell</text>
  <text x="400" y="106" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#dc2626">6 V</text>

  <!-- AMMETER 2 (Top Right Segment) -->
  <circle cx="520" cy="140" r="18" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <text x="520" y="145" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563eb">A</text>
  <text x="520" y="88" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">Current (I₂)</text>
  <text x="520" y="106" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563eb">0.5 A</text>

  <!-- LAMP 1 (Right Vertical Wire) -->
  <circle cx="620" cy="270" r="30" fill="#fef08a" opacity="0.35"/>
  <circle cx="620" cy="270" r="22" fill="#fef9c3" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="604" y1="254" x2="636" y2="286" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="604" y1="286" x2="636" y2="254" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Lamp 1 Labels -->
  <text x="658" y="265" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">Lamp 1</text>
  <text x="658" y="285" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#d97706">3 V</text>

  <!-- LAMP 2 (Bottom Horizontal Wire) -->
  <circle cx="400" cy="410" r="30" fill="#fef08a" opacity="0.35"/>
  <circle cx="400" cy="410" r="22" fill="#fef9c3" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <line x1="384" y1="394" x2="416" y2="426" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="384" y1="426" x2="416" y2="394" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Lamp 2 Labels -->
  <text x="400" y="452" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">Lamp 2</text>
  <text x="400" y="472" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#d97706">3 V</text>

  <!-- AMMETER 1 (Left Vertical Wire) -->
  <circle cx="180" cy="270" r="18" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <text x="180" y="275" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563eb">A</text>
  <text x="148" y="265" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">Current (I₁)</text>
  <text x="148" y="285" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563eb">0.5 A</text>

  <!-- Bottom Key Rules Card -->
  <rect x="70" y="495" width="660" height="70" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <text x="400" y="522" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">
    Voltage is shared:  <tspan fill="#dc2626">Cell (6 V)</tspan> = <tspan fill="#d97706">Lamp 1 (3 V)</tspan> + <tspan fill="#d97706">Lamp 2 (3 V)</tspan>
  </text>
  
  <text x="400" y="548" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563eb">
    Current is identical everywhere:  I₁ = I₂ = 0.5 A
  </text>
</svg>

title: Photosynthesis
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600">
  <title>Photosynthesis</title>
  
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- Heading -->
  <text x="400" y="45" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" fill="#1a1a1a">Photosynthesis in Plants</text>

  <!-- Motion Paths (Invisible) -->
  <defs>
    <!-- Path for Light Rays -->
    <path id="path-light1" d="M 150,115 L 420,205"/>
    <path id="path-light2" d="M 170,95 L 470,175"/>
    <path id="path-light3" d="M 120,140 L 380,245"/>

    <!-- Path for Water (Roots to Leaf) -->
    <path id="path-water" d="M 400,460 L 400,285 Q 400,265 470,240"/>

    <!-- Path for CO2 (Air to Leaf) -->
    <path id="path-co2" d="M 160,280 C 240,280 310,275 390,270"/>

    <!-- Path for Oxygen (Leaf to Air) -->
    <path id="path-oxygen" d="M 540,205 C 610,170 660,140 730,120"/>

    <!-- Path for Glucose (Inside Leaf to Stem) -->
    <path id="path-glucose" d="M 490,230 Q 450,265 405,310"/>

    <!-- Arrowhead Marker -->
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="6" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#475569"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrow-green" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="6" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#15803d"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrow-blue" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="6" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#2563eb"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrow-red" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="6" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#dc2626"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrow-cyan" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="6" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#0891b2"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- Soil Layer -->
  <path d="M 260,450 Q 400,435 540,450 L 540,500 Q 400,510 260,500 Z" fill="#fde68a" opacity="0.6"/>
  <path d="M 260,450 Q 400,435 540,450" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/>
  <text x="400" y="485" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold">Soil</text>

  <!-- Roots -->
  <g stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
    <path d="M 400,450 Q 380,470 340,480"/>
    <path d="M 400,450 Q 410,475 440,485"/>
    <path d="M 400,450 Q 395,475 390,495"/>
    <path d="M 370,465 Q 355,475 345,490"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Stem -->
  <path d="M 400,450 L 400,270" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M 400,450 L 400,270" stroke="#4ade80" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>

  <!-- Leaf Shape -->
  <path d="M 400,270 C 370,160 490,130 610,200 C 640,250 550,330 400,270 Z" fill="#22c55e" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="3.5"/>

  <!-- Leaf Veins -->
  <path d="M 400,270 Q 505,235 610,200" stroke="#86efac" stroke-width="3.5" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M 450,253 Q 470,230 490,225" stroke="#86efac" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M 480,243 Q 510,225 535,220" stroke="#86efac" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M 520,230 Q 550,215 575,212" stroke="#86efac" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M 460,250 Q 475,270 495,275" stroke="#86efac" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M 500,237 Q 520,260 545,262" stroke="#86efac" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>

  <!-- Chloroplasts (Chlorophyll details inside leaf) -->
  <g fill="#15803d" stroke="#86efac" stroke-width="1">
    <ellipse cx="460" cy="205" rx="12" ry="7" transform="rotate(-10 460 205)"/>
    <ellipse cx="510" cy="190" rx="14" ry="8" transform="rotate(15 510 190)"/>
    <ellipse cx="540" cy="235" rx="13" ry="7" transform="rotate(-5 540 235)"/>
    <ellipse cx="485" cy="280" rx="12" ry="6" transform="rotate(20 485 280)"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sun -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="32" fill="#fbbf24" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="3"/>
    <!-- Animated Sun Rays (Rotation) -->
    <g stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round">
      <line x1="100" y1="58" x2="100" y2="50"/>
      <line x1="100" y1="142" x2="100" y2="150"/>
      <line x1="58" y1="100" x2="50" y2="100"/>
      <line x1="142" y1="100" x2="150" y2="100"/>
      <line x1="70" y1="70" x2="64" y2="64"/>
      <line x1="130" y1="130" x2="136" y2="136"/>
      <line x1="70" y1="130" x2="64" y2="136"/>
      <line x1="130" y1="70" x2="136" y2="64"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 100 100" to="45 100 100" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Static Beam Guide Lines for Light Energy -->
  <line x1="130" y1="110" x2="410" y2="200" stroke="#fef08a" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
  <line x1="120" y1="130" x2="370" y2="240" stroke="#fef08a" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>

  <!-- Flow Guide Arrows (Static background arrows) -->
  <!-- CO2 In Arrow -->
  <path d="M 170,280 L 340,273" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,4" marker-end="url(#arrow)" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Water Up Arrow -->
  <path d="M 380,440 L 380,310" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,4" marker-end="url(#arrow)" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Oxygen Out Arrow -->
  <path d="M 540,205 C 610,170 650,145 700,130" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,4" marker-end="url(#arrow)" fill="none"/>

  <!-- ANIMATED PARTICLES -->

  <!-- Light Energy Photons (Yellow) -->
  <circle r="6" fill="#f59e0b" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5">
    <animateMotion dur="2.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" rotate="auto">
      <mpath href="#path-light1"/>
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>
  <circle r="6" fill="#f59e0b" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5">
    <animateMotion dur="2.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0.8s" rotate="auto">
      <mpath href="#path-light1"/>
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>
  <circle r="6" fill="#f59e0b" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5">
    <animateMotion dur="2.2s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0.3s" rotate="auto">
      <mpath href="#path-light2"/>
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>
  <circle r="6" fill="#f59e0b" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5">
    <animateMotion dur="2.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="1.2s" rotate="auto">
      <mpath href="#path-light3"/>
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>

  <!-- Water Molecules (Blue) -->
  <g fill="#2563eb" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5">
    <circle r="6">
      <animateMotion dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0s">
        <mpath href="#path-water"/>
      </animateMotion>
    </circle>
    <circle r="6">
      <animateMotion dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="1.3s">
        <mpath href="#path-water"/>
      </animateMotion>
    </circle>
    <circle r="6">
      <animateMotion dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="2.6s">
        <mpath href="#path-water"/>
      </animateMotion>
    </circle>
  </g>

  <!-- Carbon Dioxide Molecules (Red/Slate) -->
  <g fill="#dc2626" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5">
    <circle r="6">
      <animateMotion dur="3.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0s">
        <mpath href="#path-co2"/>
      </animateMotion>
    </circle>
    <circle r="6">
      <animateMotion dur="3.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="1.2s">
        <mpath href="#path-co2"/>
      </animateMotion>
    </circle>
    <circle r="6">
      <animateMotion dur="3.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="2.4s">
        <mpath href="#path-co2"/>
      </animateMotion>
    </circle>
  </g>

  <!-- Oxygen Molecules (Cyan) -->

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600">
  <title>States of Matter</title>
  
  <style>
    /* Solid vibrations */
    .sv1 { animation: vib1 0.3s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .sv2 { animation: vib2 0.35s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .sv3 { animation: vib3 0.28s infinite ease-in-out; }

    @keyframes vib1 {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(2px, -2px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-1px, 2px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-2px, -1px); }
    }
    @keyframes vib2 {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(-2px, 1px); }
      50% { transform: translate(2px, 1px); }
      75% { transform: translate(1px, -2px); }
    }
    @keyframes vib3 {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(1px, 2px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-2px, -1px); }
      75% { transform: translate(2px, -1px); }
    }

    /* Liquid drifting */
    .ld1 { animation: drift1 4.5s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .ld2 { animation: drift2 5s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .ld3 { animation: drift3 4s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .ld4 { animation: drift4 4.8s infinite ease-in-out; }

    @keyframes drift1 {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(7px, -5px); }
      66% { transform: translate(-5px, 4px); }
    }
    @keyframes drift2 {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(-6px, 6px); }
      66% { transform: translate(6px, -6px); }
    }
    @keyframes drift3 {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(5px, 7px); }
      66% { transform: translate(-7px, -4px); }
    }
    @keyframes drift4 {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(-7px, -6px); }
      66% { transform: translate(5px, 6px); }
    }

    /* Gas fast movement */
    .g1 { animation: gas1 3.5s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .g2 { animation: gas2 3.8s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .g3 { animation: gas3 3.2s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .g4 { animation: gas4 3.6s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .g5 { animation: gas5 3.4s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .g6 { animation: gas6 3.9s infinite ease-in-out; }

    @keyframes gas1 {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(150px, 80px); }
      50% { transform: translate(40px, 240px); }
      75% { transform: translate(155px, 150px); }
    }
    @keyframes gas2 {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(-150px, 110px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-60px, 235px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-155px, 45px); }
    }
    @keyframes gas3 {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(145px, -130px); }
      50% { transform: translate(135px, 115px); }
      75% { transform: translate(25px, -125px); }
    }
    @keyframes gas4 {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(-145px, 95px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-135px, -145px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-30px, 90px); }
    }
    @keyframes gas5 {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(130px, -240px); }
      50% { transform: translate(25px, -135px); }
      75% { transform: translate(120px, -245px); }
    }
    @keyframes gas6 {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(-130px, -235px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-40px, -115px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-125px, -60px); }
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <text x="400" y="52" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a">States of Matter</text>

    <!-- Row 4 -->

    <g class="sv2"><circle cx="145" cy="339" r="18" fill="#3b82f6" stroke="#1e40af" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="139" cy="333" r="5" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.5"/></g>
    <g class="sv3"><circle cx="181" cy="339" r="18" fill="#3b82f6" stroke="#1e40af" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="175" cy="333" r="5" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.5"/></g>
  </g>

  <!-- ================= LIQUID PARTICLES (12 particles, close irregular arrangement) ================= -->
  <g id="liquid-particles">
    <!-- Bottom layer -->
    <g class="ld1"><circle cx="335" cy="415" r="18" fill="#06b6d4" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="329" cy="409" r="5" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.5"/></g>

    <!-- Middle layer -->

    <g class="ld4"><circle cx="397" cy="380" r="18" fill="#06b6d4" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="391" cy="374" r="5" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.5"/></g>
